import copy,json,os,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
binary='/Volumes/KINGSTON/AIVERSE-builds/building-caverns-gate-build/aiversemcp'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as space:
    project=Path(space)/'probe'
    shutil.copytree('examples/projectiles',project)
    graph={'version':1,'domain':'material','nodes':[{'id':'input','op':'input'}],'outputs':{'color':'input'}}
    updated=copy.deepcopy(graph)
    updated['nodes'].append({'id':'tint','op':'constant','value':[1,1,1,1]})
    updated['outputs']['color']='tint'
    name='studio_merge_probe'
    requests=[('open_game',{'game':str(project)}),('shader_graph_set',dict(name=name,graph=graph)),('shader_graph_set',dict(name=name,graph=updated)),('shader_graph_set',dict(name=name,graph=updated,expected=dict(reversed(list(graph.items()))))),('shader_graph_set',dict(name=name,graph=graph,expected=graph)),('shader_graph_get',dict(name=name))]
    rows=[dict(jsonrpc='2.0',id=0,method='initialize',params={})]+[dict(jsonrpc='2.0',id=i+1,method='tools/call',params=dict(name=k,arguments=v)) for i,(k,v) in enumerate(requests)]
    out=subprocess.run([binary,'--no-editor','--port','0','--engine',os.getcwd()],input=''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in rows),text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=45,check=True)
    replies={r['id']:r for r in map(json.loads,out.stdout.splitlines()) if 'id' in r}
    for i in (1,2,4,6):
        assert not replies[i].get('error') and not replies[i]['result'].get('isError'),replies[i]
    for i in (3,5):
        assert replies[i].get('error') or replies[i]['result'].get('isError'),replies[i]
    loaded=json.loads(replies[6]['result']['content'][0]['text'])
    assert loaded['graph']==updated,loaded.keys()
    print('PASS Shader Graph native create, blind-write rejection, reordered expected graph, stale-write rejection and final readback')
